name: Samoa
summary: Samoa has no fixed heirship share found in this research, but custom and communal (matai) titles and land sit outside ordinary wills. Samoa has trust law and a Foundations Act 2016. The Hague Trusts Convention is not in force.
family_claims: Not confirmed. The Wills Act 1975 text was not read for family-provision provisions.
foreign_law_note: No conflict-of-law rule was sourced. Customary land and matai titles do not pass by will.
trust_note: Trustee Act 2017, International Trusts Act 1987 (as described in a 1999 secondary source) and Foundations Act 2016 (foundation as a legal entity with a council and guardians). Tax treatment not sourced.
open_questions: Whether the Wills Act 1975 or another law gives a family provision or heirship right.
Current status of the International Trusts Act 1987 and whether it survived the 2017 Trustee Act reform.
Rules for non-citizens holding freehold or leasehold land.
The HCCH table as retrieved shows no entry for this jurisdiction (the retrieved copy was marked last updated 2017 and its territorial-extension notes could not be read); re-check the live table.
